diagnoses.description: Atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary artery without angina pectoris

claim_lines.description: Office or other outpatient visit for evaluation and management of an established patient, high complexity
Electrocardiogram, routine ECG with at least 12 leads; with interpretation and report
Echocardiography, transthoracic, real-time with image documentation (2D), includes M-mode recording

medical_record_excerpt: Patient presented for scheduled annual cardiac follow-up and routine 12-lead ECG. Patient reports feeling well with no chest pain, shortness of breath, palpitations, or syncope. Meds reviewed: Atorvastatin 40mg, Lisinopril 10mg. BP: 128/78, Pulse: 68 bpm. ECG performed and reviewed: Normal sinus rhythm, no acute ST-T wave changes. Plan: Continue current medical regimen. Return in 12 months.

policy_sources: CMS NCCI Policy Manual, Chapter 1, Section E
AMA CPT 2024 Evaluation and Management Guidelines
CMS Medicare Program Integrity Manual (Pub. 100-08), Chapter 3

line_reviews.rationale: Record documents a routine scheduled follow-up with no acute problem, medication change, or separately identifiable service beyond the work associated with the ECG.
ECG performed with documented interpretation (normal sinus rhythm, no acute ST-T wave changes).
No order, clinical indication, images, or interpretation for a transthoracic echocardiogram appear in the submitted record.
